events.title: "White Album" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as "The White Album," on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Drop
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles dropped their iconic 'White Album'. Still sounds as fresh and groundbreaking today as it did back in '68. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the music world lost one of its most iconic frontmen, Freddie Mercury of Queen.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?

events.title: "Rubber Soul" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Release
angles.copy: Back in 1965, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly marked a shift in their sound. Still a masterpiece today.

events.title: John Lennon Tribute
events.blurb: The world tragically lost John Lennon on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who we lost on this day in 1980. A true visionary whose music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary artist David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday on this day.

angles.name: Bowie's 80th
angles.copy: Thinking of the one and only David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. A true innovator who constantly reinvented music and style. What's your go-to Bowie track?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis's 92nd
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. His legacy in music is simply unmatched.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page. The man behind some of the greatest guitar riffs in history. What's your favourite Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop legend Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years. What's your favourite Rod tune?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs, born Graham McPherson, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs' Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the brilliant Suggs, frontman of Madness! His energy and stage presence are legendary.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young. Still 'Everytime You Go Away', we miss him on the airwaves!

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music icon and cultural legend Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the incredible Dolly Parton! A true icon, songwriter, and absolute legend. What's your favourite Dolly hit?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! A fantastic songwriter and performer.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British R&B and soul singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! Get ready to 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car' and celebrate with his classic hits.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989, honouring legends like Elvis Presley and The Beatles.

angles.name: Rock Hall Inaugural
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its very first induction ceremony. Imagine being there to see those legends honoured!

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still bringing the pop magic.

events.title: Beatles Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their iconic final live public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles played their legendary rooftop concert. What an iconic way to say goodbye to live performances. If you could have been there, what song would you have wanted to hear?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Iconic singer-songwriter and Genesis drummer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins' Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to his incredible solo career, a true musical powerhouse.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Hugh Grant's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to dramas, a true British screen legend.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From NSYNC to solo hits, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Much-loved British actor Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: David Jason's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Del Boy to Frost, a true legend of British television.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, rock and roll pioneers Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Day The Music Died
angles.copy: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died'. On this day in 1959, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in a tragic plane crash. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop icon Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rick Astley's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! He's never gonna give you up, never gonna let you down... or stop making great music.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Bob Marley's Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today. His message of peace, love, and unity continues to inspire.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Iconic singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Carole King's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A true songwriting genius responsible for so many timeless hits.

events.title: Whitney Houston Tribute
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012.

angles.name: Remembering Whitney
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Whitney Houston, who we lost on this day in 2012. Her voice was truly one in a million. What's your favourite Whitney track?

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, pop sensations Take That announced their split, much to the dismay of fans worldwide.

angles.name: Take That Split
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 31 years since Take That announced their split? A day that broke many hearts, but thankfully they returned!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Ali Campbell's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40! Still bringing those reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Ed Sheeran's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 36th birthday to the incredible Ed Sheeran! What's your favourite track from the Suffolk singer-songwriter?
